title: Haughton Mars Project simulation and Chris McKay lecture

tellings.quote: we essentially played like we were Mars astronauts and my role was the robot guy

plain: John Blitch, a former scientist at DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, says that in 2001 he took part in a pretend Mars mission at Haughton Crater on Devon Island, in the Arctic, where the team played at being Mars astronauts and he was "the robot guy." He says the stay included a lecture by the scientist Chris McKay. He tells it as his own experience, part of the background to the strange encounter he later describes.
